backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining bilingual content models, access control, persistent custom domain, user profiles, and CRUD endpoints for organization data with blob storage support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module initializing the new persistent actor state, currently setting customDomain to null.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing backend and frontend files involved in domain management updates with related components and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their roles in routing, UI, admin tools, and bilingual content handling.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining IC hosting requirements, hash-based routing, and post-deployment verification steps.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app root and main script with metadata and viewport configuration.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React entry configuring TanStack Router with hash history, providers, routes, and global query client.
frontend/src/components/admin/AboutUsEdi: Admin form for editing About Us content in English and Hindi with tabs and save functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/ContactMes: Admin viewer that lists contact form submissions with sender details and message text.
frontend/src/components/admin/GalleryMan: Admin tool to upload, preview, caption, and delete gallery images with multilingual support.
frontend/src/components/admin/HomePageIm: Admin interface for adding, previewing, and deleting home page images with bilingual captions.
frontend/src/components/admin/Organizati: Admin form to edit organization details, mission, and logo with English/Hindi fields.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProjectsMa: Provides UI and logic to list, add, edit, and delete projects with image upload and multilingual fields.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying bilingual organization info, contact details, social links, and logo with fallback handling.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive site header with navigation links, language switcher, and admin controls based on authentication.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering the header, routed content, and footer.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Implements admin auth state with session/local storage, login via hashed credentials, and logout handling.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Manages language state (English/Hindi) with persistence and a translation helper.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, stored-identity loading, and context state for authentication workflow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend calls with React Query for organization details, about content, projects, and gallery operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, InternetIdentityProvider, React Query provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays About Us content using language selection and fetched multilingual text.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Handles admin login and first-time admin setup with credential validation and redirects authenticated users to the admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Renders the admin dashboard with editors, domain settings, and authentication checks before granting access.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays organization contact details and a form for users to submit messages stored via mutations.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Fetches and displays gallery images with localized captions, showing loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the homepage hero and recent activities sections using organization details and gallery images with language support.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Provides a 404 page with navigation options and localized messaging for missing routes.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Displays a projects list with localization support, loading state, and project cards with images, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/utils/domainValidation.ts: Provides functions to validate and normalize custom domain names with multiple format and length checks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, and managing persisted values across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, and theme settings with plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, features, and domain-related requirements for the Uthaan Sewa Samiti website.
